critical_code_review_comments: support_escalations.py — _EscalationBroker is single-pod safe with proper asyncio.Lock around subscribe/unsubscribe and QueueFull silent-drop for slow consumers. Verified via 3-subscriber fan-out live test.

SSE endpoint accepts JWT via Authorization header, session_token cookie, OR ?token=<jwt> query (EventSource fallback) — all three paths exercised by tests. 401 missing token, 403 non-admin role enforced server-side BEFORE subscribing to broker.

POST /api/support/escalate publishes to broker BEFORE the (best-effort) admin email — chime/notification fires within ~50ms even if SendGrid is degraded. Both publish() and _email_admin are individually try/except wrapped so neither can break the 200 response.
Initial `event: ready` payload includes open_count snapshot — clients can reconcile state across reconnects without polling. Keepalive comments every 25s prevent proxy timeouts.

WATCHDOG_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION (services/genai_direct_client.py) iter321 strict marker contract verified: contains anti-pattern 'INCORRECT (NO ticket gets created' section, 'No marker = no ticket' hard line, PART 1 (marker) ordered BEFORE PART 2 (confirmation), 'NOT wrapped in any markdown fences' rule, and distinct post-emit phrase '✅ Ticket already created' / '✅ Demande déjà créée' to prevent pre/post-emit conflation.
Frontend AIAssistant.js — Talk-to-Human button is correctly gated on logged-in users (visible only in buyer session; manual-escalation-modal works end-to-end including bubble append + toast).
